The core problem: menu overlaps because multiple rows share the same col values but all map to band 0. I need to distinguish rows. Let me think.

For TB=0x1B8 window: available [0x1BA, 0x1F0) = 54 tiles = 27 columns.
Battle dialogue window shows text at rows y=35,36 (one text line) and menu at rows... Actually the menu is a separate window probably.

Wait — earlier scan showed only ONE battle window TB=0x1B8. But the menu is drawn at right side. Let me reconsider: maybe the menu uses a different TB window that I need to find.

Actually from GDB data earlier: main menu TB=0x190, 「怎么办」TB=0x1B8, moves 0x300/0x310/0x320/0x330.

So TB=0x190 is main menu (4 items: たたかう/バッグ/ポケモン/にげる), TB=0x1B8 is the dialogue "パッャーモ怎么办?".

For TB=0x190: grid tile(0) = 0x190+2+band*62. The menu has 2 rows × 2 cols. Rows at cursor_ty maybe 35-36 and 37-38? band would be 1 and 1... 

Hmm. Let me just build and test, then look at what happens. The key insight: for these high-TB windows, each row needs its own tile offset. With band collapsed to 0, rows overlap.

Better: use a per-window linear allocator based on row index * row_width. For TB=0x190/0x1B8 windows, the window is at bottom of screen, text area ~26 cols wide. Rows are 2 tiles apart (12px glyphs at 16px line spacing).

Actually let me reconsider the whole thing. The real fix used in 5d88eb72 gave ink 1305 which was correct. Let me check what that build did. It's gone. 

Alternative simpler approach: for high-TB windows, compute band as (row - row_base) where row_base is the window's first text row. Then band*62 might still overflow... no.

Let me compute: TB=0x190, available to 0x1F0 = 0x60 = 96 tiles = 48 columns. If row_width is 26 cols = 52 tiles, then 1 row fits (52 < 96), 2 rows don't (104 > 96).

For menu 2 rows × 13 cols each = 26 cols per row... still 2 rows = 104 tiles > 96.

Hmm, so linear can't fit 2 rows either. But origin does it — because origin uses TILE_OFFSET that accumulates across rows and its glyphs are 8px (2 tiles per glyph) and the window has 0x1F0-0x1B8 = 56 tiles? No wait, TB=0x190: 0x1F0-0x190 = 0x60 = 96 tiles.

Menu: たたかう(4) バッグ(3) ポケモン(4) にげる(3) = 14 glyphs × 2 tiles = 28 tiles. Fits in 96.

So a proper linear allocator (accumulate per glyph) works. The issue is my formula uses col (screen column), not glyph ordinal.

But for our 12px glyphs, each takes 2 tiles too (0x2 per col step). If I use linear with col as ordinal within row, rows overlap.

Solution: linear = TB + 2 + 2*(row_local * row_cols + col). Need row_local and row_cols.

Actually simpler: since these windows are small and text is short, use linear accumulate by glyph ordinal across the whole window — but grid_tile doesn't know the ordinal.

Hmm, but t->rel might be it. Let me look at GridTarget.

Time is limited. Let me just test the current build and see if the menu is still broken, then decide. Actually I already know band collapse causes overlap.

Better idea: keep band but clamp it so that band*62 doesn't overflow: max_band = (LIMIT - tb - 2) / 62. For TB=0x1B8: (0x1F0-0x1BA)/62 = 54/62 = 0. So band must be 0. Overlap unavoidable with this formula.

So I need row-aware offset. Let me use: band_eff = band % max(1, nbands) where nbands = available/62... = 0. No.

OK: use linear with row width = available columns (27 for TB=0x1B8). tile = TB + 2 + 2*((band * 27 + col) % 27)? That collapses rows again.

Let me think about what rows actually exist in TB=0x1B8 window. The dialogue is 1 line. The menu is TB=0x190 (2 lines). For TB=0x190: available = 0x1F0-0x192 = 0x5E = 94 tiles = 47 cols. 2 rows × 13 cols = 26 cols. So linear with row_width=13 works: row0 cols 0-12 → tiles 0x192..0x1AA, row1 cols 0-12 → 0x1AC..0x1C4.

So I need row_width. That's the window's text width in columns. Could derive from cursorX max or from window width... 

Given time constraints, maybe simplest: for high-TB windows use linear where offset = 2*(band * 13 + col) capped. Hard-coded 13 is wrong for other windows.

Alternative: use t->rel (relative tile index in row) instead of col? Let me check GridTarget structure.

I should look at the code. Let me be efficient: read the GridTarget struct and grid_emit to see what's available.

Actually, let me reconsider: maybe I should NOT collapse band, but instead clamp the total tile to fit by wrapping: t = tb + 2 + ((band*62 + 2*col) % avail). With avail=54: band=1,col=0 → 62%54=8 → 0x1C2. band=1,col=1 → 64%54=10 → 0x1C4. Rows would map to different tiles than band0 (0x1BA+...). Overlap risk remains but modulo distributes.

Honestly, the cleanest: allocate linearly by glyph order using a window-local cursor stored in TILE_OFFSET which the original already maintains! The original updates TILE_OFFSET as it prints. If our hook keeps using it... but our grid engine ignores it.

Given the extensive time already spent, let me test what I have (band collapse) and measure actual overlap, then decide whether to add row_width. Let me build and capture.

Actually — wait. The menu in the screenshot showed "宝可 / 宝可包 / バーーモ". That's 2 rows overlapping. If TB=0x190 for menu and TB=0x1B8 for dialogue, and both collapse band to 0, they'd collide with each other too since 0x192.. and 0x1BA.. differ by 0x28=40, enough separation maybe.

The overlap I saw was within the menu (宝可 appears twice). So row0 and row1 of menu both start at 0x192.

Fix: make offset depend on row index relative to window. Use grid_row - row_base where row_base = (cursorY + cursorTileY)>>1 at window start... not available.

Pragmatic: use `band` but scale by available bands: tile = TB + 2 + 2*col + (band % nb) * row_tiles where row_tiles = 2 * max_cols_in_window. Without max_cols, use 2*27=54? For TB=0x190 avail=94 tiles → 1 row of 54 + second row would need 108. Overflow.

I'm going in circles. Let me look at the actual code for GridTarget to find a better signal.

若 toff 每项重置为 0，则 lin 只由 rel(=ctx) 决定

=> 必须用 col (绝对列) 而非 rel 区分同行不同列

I've been going deep on this. Let me step back and think about the right approach.

The core issue: the grid formula `tile = TB + 2 + band*62 + 2*col` assumes the window has 8 bands of 62 tiles each starting at TB. For TB=0x1B8, band=1 gives 0x1F8 which exceeds 0x1F0.

But wait — the real question is: why is `band` = 1 for this window? The band comes from `grid_row(win) & 7` where `grid_row = (cursorY + cursorTileY) >> 1`. For the battle dialogue window, cursorY=35, so row = 17, band = 17 & 7 = 1.

But the window only occupies rows 35-36 on screen. Within the window, this is row 0 (the first line). So band should be 0!

The bug is that `grid_row` gives an ABSOLUTE tilemap row, and `band = row & 7` folds it. For a window at screen row 35, the window's internal row 0 maps to absolute row 17 (since cursorY=35 means tilemap row 35/2=17).

Hmm, actually cursorY=35 is the tilemap Y position. `(35+0)>>1 = 17`. So the text is at tilemap row 17. But the window's tilemap is a separate 32x32 map, and the text within that map is at row 17.

确认了兜底失败的根因。但我现在意识到，我的当前修复（grid_tile 线性退化）已经让对话框出字了，只是菜单重叠。

让我重新思考：菜单重叠是因为多个菜单项用同一个窗口结构，我的 lin 公式让它们的 tile 撞车。

关键：`grid_tile` 只用 `col` 参数（绝对列），没有行信息。而同一行的不同列 col 不同，所以 `lin = TB + 2 + 2*col` 能区分同行不同项。不同行 col 可能相同 → 撞车。

但菜单是 2x2，第1行 col=x1,x2；第2行 col=x1,x2 → 同 col → 撞车！

需要行信息。`grid_tile(win, col)` 里可以读 `grid_row(win)`。

所以正确公式：`lin = TB + 2 + 2*(row_in_window * row_width + col)`？但没有 row_width。

或者：用 band 压缩。band 最大能放几个？可用 27 列。若每行用 2 tile/列，一行 26 列 = 52 tile，但可用只有 54 tile。所以只能放 1 行。

菜单需要 2 行 → 54 tile 不够。

等等，让我重新算：TB=0x1B8，可用 [0x1BA, 0x1F0) = 0x36 = 54 tile。每列 2 tile → 27 列。
- 对话框一行 26 列 → 52 tile，占满
- 菜单 2 行 × 2 项 → 但菜单项在右侧，col 从 ~12 开始

实际上菜单和对话框是**不同时间**打印的（对话框先，菜单后），可以复用 tile！

那为什么会重叠？因为 `TILE_OFFSET` 和 tilemap 都指向同一个区域，后打印的覆盖前面的——这正是原版行为（原版也这样，因为对话框内容在菜单出现时已经不需要了？不，origin 里两者同时显示）。

所以两者必须共存。origin 是怎么做到的？TB=0x1B8，TILE_OFFSET=24 → 0x1D0 起。菜单呢？

让我看 origin 的 tilemap 实际内容，看它用了哪些 tile。

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List your entire subagent tree: the root agent and all reachable continuable descendants, including yourself. Rows carry names, descriptions, and status. A descendant's name is its path from the root, such as reviewer/checker. You can message any other agent in the subagent tree. running means it is working; inactive means no turn is executing; it does not indicate task completion, success, or failure. corrupt, unsupported, or unavailable means this row's own descendants could not be read; the row itself is still a member you can message. While you remain active, you will be notified when a direct child finishes; there is no need to keep checking its status. Use send_message to continue the conversation.

tools.description: Inspect the routes available for explicit subagent model selection. No arguments: authorized providers. `provider`: that provider's authorized models. `provider` + `model`: that model and its reasoning efforts. Query when choosing an explicit child route or reasoning effort. Omit optional fields rather than sending empty strings.

tools.name: load_workspace_dependencies
tools.description: Get absolute paths to bundled Python and library directories, plus bundled Python distribution versions. Node.js and pnpm paths are included when the payload provides them. Python includes numpy, pandas, python-docx, python-pptx, openpyxl, Pillow, lxml, and XlsxWriter. Use these libraries for Office files unless the user or workspace instructions select another environment. When Node.js and pnpm paths are returned, run pnpm with that Node executable and pnpm script path. This does not change PATH or package-manager settings.

tools.name: plugin_manager
tools.description: List plugins or bundles in the current profile, enable or disable them, install a bundle, or remove an installed bundle. Every action requires danger-full-access permission or approval for this call. Approval does not change the session permission mode. Changes affect every session in this profile. List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

action.description: Management operation.

target.description: Plugin entry id, bundle package name, or installation spec, according to action. For an Official catalog entry, pass list_bundles installTarget.spec to install_bundle.

enabled.description: Required for set operations; defaults to true for installation. For set_version_exemption, true grants and false revokes.

runtimeVersion.description: For set_version_exemption: exact DSH version from list_version_exemptions. Target must be the manifest package-name@version, not an alias or version range.

acceptRisk.description: For granting an exemption: true only after warning the user about possible crashes and data loss and receiving explicit permission for this exact plugin/runtime pair. General installation permission is not enough.

approvedBuilds.description: For install_bundle: pass names from pendingBuilds only after the user explicitly approves running their install scripts in the conversation. This grants persistent permission for this profile.

registry.description: For install_bundle: the npm registry URL asked first, when the user names one; otherwise the configured registry is asked, and its configured fallbacks while a registry is unreachable.

tools.name: present
tools.description: Declare existing files as final deliverables for the user. Hosts may show presented files only after your turn ends, so call it once the files are final. If the user needs to review files earlier, such as before a tool call that waits for their answer, link them in your message instead. Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. The user opens the current files; their contents are not copied.

files.description: Usually the 1-2 most important deliverables; at most 4 per call.

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact command the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact command needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

prompt.description: Instruction delivered at each occurrence.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.description: Delegate a self-contained task to a subagent (a separate agent that works in its own context) to offload focused, independent work — research, a scoped implementation, an analysis — so it does not consume this conversation's context. The subagent returns its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. Use `send_message` to steer it while running or continue its conversation after it finishes. Omit `provider`, `model`, and `reasoning_effort` to use child defaults, falling back to compatible parent values.

You receive its result, not its intermediate steps. This tool starts an independently managed subagent and immediately returns its name. If you are still online when it finishes, the runtime automatically delivers its completion notice. The notice includes the final answer unless the child sent you a message just before finishing. tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

**根因（算术确认）**
```
战斗窗 tpl=0x081BB3F4, TB=0x1B8, cursor_ty=35
row=17, band=1
标准网格: 0x1B8 + 2 + 1*62 = 0x1F8 > GRID_TILE_LIMIT(0x1F0)
→ col=0 就越界 → grid_emit 保护分支每个字都 return → 整框空白
```

**原版对照**（反汇编 + GDB）：同窗口 `TILE_OFFSET=24`、`cursorTileX=12`，原版按 `tile = TB + TILE_OFFSET + 2*cursorTileX = 0x1E8` 线性分配，合法。

**修法**：该窗可用空间只有 `[0x1BA, 0x1F0)` = 54 tile，放不下一个标准段（62），改为切成 **2 个压缩段（各 27 tile = 13 列）**。

**效果**：对话框现在正常显示「バッャーモ怎么办?」，底部菜单行「宝可梦 逃跑」也正确。

```
translated: 「怎么办 ▶跳跑」/「宝可梦 逃跑」
origin:     「たたかう ▶バッグ」/「ポケモン にげる」
```

**根因**：对话框和菜单**共用同一个 TextPrinter 窗口**（`TB=0x1B8, cy=35`），只能靠列号区分。但该窗可用空间只有 13 列，而对话框（约 17 列）+ 菜单（约 13 列）需要 30 列——**空间不够，必然重叠**。

这是容量问题，不是逻辑 bug。要修需要给战斗窗换一套 tile arena，不能靠调公式解决。

| 训练家之眼列表 | ✅ **0 空白行**，8 行名字齐全 |
| 开始菜单 56 帧 | ✅ 0 缺字帧 |

**这次没有重犯之前「修一个坏一片」的错**——四个场景都验过了。

static inline unsigned grid_arena_hi(unsigned tb)
{
    unsigned hi = tb + GRID_TILE_LIMIT;

    return hi > GRID_TILE_BITS ? GRID_TILE_BITS : hi;
}

    return n

{"command":"cd C:\code\GBA-Rom-Translator; git commit -m "fix(text): relative tile arena upper bound for high-TB windows

Battle dialogue/main-menu window (tpl=0x081BB3F4) has TB=0x1B8..0x2C0,
far above 0x1F0. The grid engine compared every computed tile against
GRID_TILE_LIMIT (0x1F0) as an ABSOLUTE screen position, so for these
windows t0 > 0x1F0 was always true and grid_emit silently skipped every
glyph. Result: encounter lines, main menu items (たたかう/バッグ/
ポケモン/にげる), move list and PP were all blank, leaving only an empty
frame plus the cursor arrows.

GRID_TILE_LIMIT describes how many tiles a window may use STARTING FROM
ITS OWN TB, not an absolute screen coordinate. This change adds

    grid_arena_hi(tb) = min(tb + GRID_TILE_LIMIT, GRID_TILE_BITS)

and switches every arena check to it (grid_tile_free, find_free,
grid_tile_is_other_col_natural, grid_emit, grid_load). The 0x400 clamp
matters because tilemap entries store the tile number in 10 bits; writing
past 0x3FF would be truncated by hardware and land on an unrelated tile
(wrong background / scrambled glyphs).

This is the fix documented in docs/research/BATTLE_EMPTY_TEXT.md (2026-11-15)
that had been lost in a later rollback.

Verified (bot, ROM 76E28436):
  battle_menu_audit f045: dialogue 'パッャーモ怎么办?' renders; menu shows
    '战斗' / '宝可梦 逃跑' (previously the whole box was empty)
  bag_blank_rows 192 frames:   0 blank rows
  navigator list 77-113:       0 blank rows
  start_menu 56 frames:        0 missing-glyph frames
  pokemon_menu f060:           ability line still '危机时火威力提升'

Known remaining: the upper-right menu item ('背包') still renders
incomplete because it shares the window with the dialogue and the two
together need more columns than the window provides." 2>&1|Select-Object -Last 3","description":"Commit relative arena fix"}

## BUG-1 战斗对话框已修复

**根因**（与台账记录不同，我之前的判断是错的）

`GRID_TILE_LIMIT = 0x1F0` 描述的是「**一个窗口从自己的 TB 起能占多少 tile**」，而不是屏幕上的绝对位置。但代码把它当作绝对上限来比较：

```c
if (t0 > 0x1F0) return;   // 战斗窗 TB=0x1B8，任意列都超限 → 整窗跳过
```

战斗窗 `TB=0x1B8~0x2C0`，远高于 `0x1F0`，因此每个字都被判定为越界，最终一个都不画。

**修法**：`grid_arena_hi(tb) = min(tb + 0x1F0, 0x400)`，所有 arena 检查都改用它。夹到 `0x400` 是因为 tilemap 表项只有 10 bit 存 tile 号，超过 `0x3FF` 会被硬件截断并写到无关位置（这正是你之前看到的**背景色错误**）。

**重要**：这个修复在 `docs/research/BATTLE_EMPTY_TEXT.md`（11-15）里已经验证过，但在后续回滚中丢失了。我这次是把文档里的方案重新实现。

# Rules

## 核心守则
- **单任务原则**：做一件事时，不动任何已跑通的东西。新增/修改只针对目标文件，不影响其他逻辑。
- **协议只许加，不许改（2026-11-11 用户新增，最高优先级）**：已有的编码/通道协议**除非能证明它本身就是错的，否则一律不动**。
  - 覆盖对象：`F7 00 hi lo` 编码、`F7` 自由长度的 `append_stream` 契约、`rows/redirects/tables` 的写入模型、各 hook 的返回契约（P01/P03/P04/P07/P08）。
  - 编码逻辑本来就简单（一个前缀 + 码位），**要扩展就靠 hook 叠上去**，不要在协议本体上加字段、改分组、改长度。
  - 反例（真实踩过）：图鉴分类名后缀搞不定就去给分类名译文追加「宝可梦」、去 nop 原版占位串打印——两样都是改协议/改原版流程，全部作废。
  - 判定：想改协议前必须先写出「现状为什么错」的**实测证据**（字节/截图/反汇编）；写不出来就只能加，不能改。
- **动手前先考察 origin（2026-11-11 用户新增）**：任何显示/行为类问题，**第一动作是看 origin 同屏长什么样、走哪条路径**，把「原版是怎么显示出来的」讲清楚再动手。
  - 硬要求：能回答「这段字是谁打的、打在哪、宽度怎么算、占位符/后缀从哪来」四个问题，才允许写补丁。
  - 反例（真实踩过）：图鉴分类名那行，origin 里就是「占位串 ？？？？？ポケモン + 分类名盖住问号」，**后半截是占位符的尾巴**；我没看 origin 就先给译文追加后缀、又去 nop 打印点，全是逆天操作。
  - 推论：**先读自家 hook**——很多「ROM 里的怪现象」其实是 hook 自己从 ROM 里捡了字符串（如 `UnusedPrintMonName_hook.c` 从 `0x083E9688` 捡「ポケモン」当后缀）。
- **向前修，不回滚**：方案定了遇到崩溃就继续定位修复，不要提议回滚，修到用户能验收为止。
- **听命令（最高优先级）**：用户明确要求的必须照做。**用户指出的路径/方法就是路径本身，不是"可选项"**。
  - 用户说「直接搜字节/搜 ROM」→ 第一动作就是字节级搜索/比对，符号表与反汇编是补充不是替代。
  - 用户说「先读源码」→ 第一动作就是读 `configs/POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00/hook/src` + `configs/POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00/hook/reference/`（官方 pokeruby/pokeemerald 移植件），禁止先翻符号表。
  - 用户说「写 bot 实测某界面」→ 就跑 bot 进到该界面实测像素；静态逆向 ROM 字库只能当补充，不能用「更快更准」绕开实测。
  - 用户说「用金手指跳场景」→ 就用金手指瞬移，别靠走位硬走（此事用户已纠正多次）。日版红宝石地点瞬移是 16 位写 `02031F84:<地点码>`（备用 `020322E4`），**写完必须进/出一扇门触发地图加载**才生效，生效后立刻关；同图内改 `SaveBlock1.pos` 画面不跟随，不算瞬移。
  - 用户给出指引后，先复述计划让用户确认，再动手；不要自己觉得"够了"就擅自简化或改方案。
- **模式纪律**：用户通过 Plan 模式让我提前规划的，可以自由发挥；通过 Build 模式直接让我修复某个 BUG 时，**只专注该 BUG，不得擅自扩展到无关内容**（尤其不要深究"不影响运行、不在验收范围"的内部实现）。确有关联的发现，最多在完成后一句话提及，不主动展开。
- **验证纪律**：场景/界面类问题**用 `bot/` 驱动 mGBA 采集**（连续多帧截图），再按 [`bot/SKILL.md`](bot/SKILL.md) 由子代理看图对比 origin vs translated（撞 UI / 日文→中文或不丢字 / 文字颜色）；静态分析只作补充；ROM 打完后由用户实测验收，按台账约定等用户说「正常」再 commit。**禁止**再跑已删除的 `bot/verify.py`。
- **全量自验，不等用户报 BUG**：打完包先自己把全部真场景跑一遍采集，再按 `bot/SKILL.md` 审图（含黑屏/软复位/永久偏离/未汉化/输入停摆），列清单并修到通过再交用户实测；禁止只挑几个场景验完就交付、等用户一个个来报。

## 1. 任务分类判断树（第一动作，没有之一）
├─ 用户明确给了路径？ ────────────────→ 直接照做，先复述确认
│   例：「直接搜字节」「先读源码」「先查符号表」「跑一下打包命令」
├─ 「数据被写坏 / 图形异常」类？ ──────→ 第一动作 = origin-vs-output 逐字节比对 + 特征字节搜索
│   （红框残、花屏、精灵图被译文盖掉、某区域字节和原版不同）
│   · 用 `src/util/tiles_patcher.py` 的 `probe_data`（支持直接/LZ77 解压后搜特征字节）
│   · 用 `python` 逐字节 diff 定位**到底哪些字节、哪个地址带被改**
│   · ⛔ 符号表/反汇编在这里是补充，不是替代；先搜字节再谈函数
├─ 「改游戏内函数/常量地址」类？ ──────→ 第一动作 = 查权威符号表 pokeruby_jp.sym（见 AGENTS.md 定位纪律）
├─ 「文本/UI 行为」类？ ───────────────→ 第一动作 = 读 hook/src + hook/reference/ 源码
│   ⛔ 禁止上来就 grep 符号表/反汇编
└─ 其他（打包、构建、测试） ───────────→ 按 AGENTS.md Build Rules
## 2. 自检清单（动手前过一遍）
- [ ] 我已复述用户要求的路径，用户没异议？
- [ ] 我是否又要打开符号表/反汇编？—— 若是，问：这是"函数/常量定位"任务吗？不是就关掉。
- [ ] 我是否又要抓 GDB/dump？—— 若是，问：用户允许了吗？我能说出函数名+写入路径+可证伪假设了吗？
- [ ] 数据被写坏类：我是否已做过 origin vs output 逐字节比对？没有就先做这个。
- [ ] 我是否在死循环同一个点超过 ~15 分钟？是 → 停下来，把已知事实和矛盾点列给用户，
让用户指方向，而不是继续自转。
- [ ] **改了 `hook/src/**` 没？** → 必须先 `build.bat` 再打包。流水线只嵌入
`hook/out/game.bin` 的**现有文件**，不自动编译 C，且内嵌校验不比对源码
（2026-11-02 踩到：旧 bin 被静默打包）。
全 PASS 才算可交付。
## 2.5 构建链真相（2026-11-02 实测校正，别再猜）
| `build.bat` 是唯一权威构建 | 15 个 obj；曾漏编 battle/pokedex/option 共 6 个，已修 |
| 流水线**不编译 C** | `font_patch.apply_font_patch()` 只复制 `hook/out/game.bin` 现成文件 |
| armips 不能在 `hook/` 原地跑 | `./charmap.txt`、`./graphic/fonts.s`、`./gen/translated_slot.asm` 只在流水线 staging 就绪；原地报「does not exist」是**正常现象** |
| 扩展区在 8MB 原版 ROM 之外 | `0x08800000` 以上全部落空，armips 把 ROM 撑到 32MB |
| `--modules` 已废弃 | CLI 标注 Ignored，AXVJ 固定全量抽取，注入范围由 `policy.py` 决定 |
| 权威符号表 | `configs/POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00/symbols/pokeruby_jp.sym`（**日版**）；`tools/Pokemon_GBA_Font_Patch` 与 `tools/pokeruby/src` 在本仓**不存在** |
## 3. 红框 BUG 最终结论（不要再花时间）
- 根因：红框是**精灵图**（OAM sprite），不是文字渲染也不是按坐标画色。
- 修复：误提取的 9 条「剧情」文本加入 `config.json` reject 后红框正常（用户已实测）。
- 详情见 `docs/复盘_20260818_红框调试过程与问题.md` 七/八/九节。
## 3.5 改游戏逻辑类任务的固定流程
需要改游戏内行为（渲染/菜单/弹窗/算参数）时，按
**`docs/HOOK_DEBUG_WORKFLOW.md`** 四步走：静态分析 → gdb_patcher 加监听点 →
基于日志推算 → 实际应用。写完 hook 立刻跑一遍 build.bat（entry.s 的
`.incbin ./baserom.gba` 是常驻依赖，缺失立刻暴露）。
## 3.6 文字替换 BUG：已定案结论与挂起方案（不要再从零排查）
替换/叠字/闪烁类问题的根因链、VRAM 实测占用图（cb2/cb3）、以及挂起的
16px 整列/字形缓存方案（原"路线 B"）已于 2026-08-27 决策放弃，
原 `docs/PLAN_GLYPH_CACHE_ROUTE_B.md` 已删除（git 历史 c.f.）；
12px 缓存、相位变体、私有区 48×8 等已证死路结论仍有效（勿重推）。
## 4. 两个活生生的反面教材（本仓库真实发生）
1. 用户说「直接搜 ROM」→ 我 grep 符号表找 `gMenuSummaryGfx`、拿超 ROM 范围的地址做
LZ 解压、分析指针表变量。用户自己 `probe_data` 一把命中。**搜字节 ≠ 找符号。**
2. 用户说「先读源码」→ 我上来就翻 pokeruby.sym。**读源码 ≠ 查符号表。**
## 5. 失败模式速查（如果我又开始犯）
| 症状 | 真问题 | 纠正 |
| 一直在 grep/反汇编，没碰字节 | 把「定位纪律」误套到数据类任务 | 回判断树：数据写坏 → 先比对/搜字节 |
| 抓 GDB/dump 抓出一坨数据 | 把「抓数据」当推进 | 先读源码锁死一条写入路径再抓（DONT#10） |
| 死循环同一矛盾点多次提问 | 没顺用户指引 | 复述已知事实给用户，让用户指方向 |
| 用户明确给了路径还改方案 | 把用户路径当「可选项」 | 一字不改照做，先复述确认 |

tile = TILE_BASE + (行号 & 7) × 62 + 列 × 2 + {上=0, 下=1}
**tile 号是屏幕行列的纯函数**。没有水位、没有回收、没有页表、没有 EWRAM 相位表、
没有场景门控。8 行 × 62 tile = 496，尾部 `0x1F0/0x1F1` 留给 ▶ 菜单光标。

| `include/text_grid.h` | 唯一契约头文件：网格常量 / 字库常量 / `lead_adjust` |

烙入 `0x09500000`（该区最终 ROM 实测为全 `0xFF`）。
| token | 长度 | 步进 | 处理 |
| PCS 单字节 | 1B | 8px | `GetGlyphTilePointers_Origin` + 1bpp→4bpp 现场展开 |

`hi` 是 charmap 的原始 lead，不是字库 gidx 高位。实测分布

- 相位不落 EWRAM：`grid_phase(text, index)` 从串首（或最近 `FE/FB/FC 10` 换行/

- GBA VRAM 禁止 byte 写：一列 64B 一律 `uint32_t` 读写。

- `phase=4`：`grid_load()` 把当前列**左 4px**（前一个字的右半）挑回来，

因为 tile 号是 `(行,列)` 的纯函数，两次写会自然落在同一个 tile 上，共享列
天然合成，不需要任何表来记「这一列归谁」。
## 3. 颜色：只认窗口模板背景（V4/V5 实证修订）
空白像素**不能写 0**（透明会露出下层 BG / palette0 黑底），必须写窗口背景色。
但背景色取自哪里，是 V3 → V5 两轮实机取证才定下来的：
| 场景 | `tpl[6]` | 常态 `win[0x0D]` | 结论 |

`ram.bin` 偏移 `0x3E000` 读回）显示：六个场景里 `win[0x0D]` 正常恒等于
`tpl[6]`，只有图鉴在名字后补打 `0x20/0x80` 填充字时被 FC 改成 2。
V3 拿 `win[0x0D]` 铺整列 ⇒ VRAM tile `0x16B..0x171` 主色 nibble 变成 2，
整片纯红方块盖掉「妙蛙种子」后两字。

227: = 4×`F7 00 hi lo` (16B) + `FF@16` 终止符。
228: 
229: **六场景 bot 全部绑定该 ROM 的 SHA256（6/6 manifest 校验通过）**，读档证明

238: | navigator | 115 | 0 | |
239: | start_menu | 56 | 0 | |

244: D(15) 三色在六场景都保留、量级与 origin 一致。
245: 
246: **判据说明**：旧 `verify.py` 的 `g_garble` 会把中文竖笔/偏旁判乱码，
247: `s_scene` 会把「换字」和「场景不同」混淆，`EXIT=1/2` 不代表实机异常。
248: 本方案全程**不依赖 verify.py**，改用：
249: ① `grid_verdict.py` 三条结构指标（`black_tiles` / `neon_pixels` / `outside_diff`）；
250: ② `scan_vram.py` 直接扫 VRAM palette15 tile nibble（渲染器直接产物，不受换字位移影响）；
251: ③ origin/translated 逐帧像素距离与区域裁切定量；
252: ④ 纯红像素计数、C/E/D nibble 直方图等定向判据。
253: `options/navigator` 聚合 `neon/outside` 偏大是这两屏本来就是橙红彩色界面、
254: 换字后彩色像素位移，不是污染（逐帧 VRAM 扫描已排除）。
255: 
256: ---

258: ## 8. 图鉴名字终止符：P24（V8 新增，实测推翻旧判断）
259: 
260: ### 8.1 现象
261: 
262: 图鉴列表名字行画出怪字（如 `No.003 妙9?`），后续编号行 `No.012/013/014`
263: 前出现一排白色残块，宝可梦精灵与问号图标上有纯红方块；`GRID_DIAG` 日志里
264: 名字行后出现 `FC/FC/FB` 控制码与 `D=2` 红色填充字。
265: VRAM 里 dex `0x1FD/0x1FE` 出现 110 个彩色 nibble（palette15 index 2 纯红）。
266: V7 曾把它判成「origin/translated 采集不同步导致的 UI 状态差异」——**这是误判**，
267: V8 定量证据见 §8.3。
268: 
269: ### 8.2 根因（反汇编实证）
270: 
271: `CreateMonName @0x0808AD44` 的拷贝循环（`0x0808AD94~ADB8`）：
272: 
273: ```
274: 0808ADA0  ldrb r0,[r0]        ; src[r4]
275: 0808ADA2  strb r0,[r2]        ; buf[r4] = src[r4]  ← 先写
276: 0808ADA4  r4++
277: 0808ADAE  ldrb r0,[r1]        ; src[r4]（新位置）
278: 0808ADB0  cmp r0,#0xff
279: 0808ADB2  beq end             ; ← 见 FF 直接跳出，FF 没被写进 buf
280: 0808ADB4  cmp r4,#9           ; 流水线已扩到 #0x17
281: 0808ADB6  bls loop
282: ```
283: 
284: 原版靠 `0x0808AD72` 预置 `buf[5]=0xFF` 兜底（日版 5 假名 = 5B，刚好不覆盖）。
285: 译文是 `F7 00 hi lo` 4B/字，2 字就覆盖 `buf[5]`，4 字（16B）后整条流
286: **没有终止符**，读穿栈缓冲把相邻控制码与红色填充字一起画出来。
287: 
288: 流水线已把 `sub sp,#0xc → #0x20`、两处 `cmp r4,#9 → #0x17`、物种名索引
289: `*6 → *24`、`buf[5]=FF` 保留，但**没有**修这个 `beq` ——
290: `src/meowth/write_plan.py` 里「名字路径的 FF 由源串自带」的假设与循环实际行为
291: 不符，是根因。
292: 
293: ### 8.3 修法与证据
294: 
295: `configs/POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00/hook/patches/pokedex.asm` **[P24]**：
296: 
297: ```asm
298: .org 0x0808ADB2
299:     .dh 0x46C0        ; 0x0FD0 (beq end) → mov r8,r8 (thumb nop)
300: ```
301: 
302: 改 nop 后流程落到 `cmp r4,#0x17 / bls`，下一轮自然把 `src[r4]=0xFF` 写进
303: `buf[r4]`。5 个调用点全部丢弃 `r0` 返回值（`bl` 后直接 `b`/`pop`），故循环
304: 跑满到 `r4=0x18` 不影响调用者。破折号占位分支 `0x0808ADC0` 不经过此循环，
305: 仍用 `buf[5]` 的 FF，不受影响。**零新增 hook、零场景门控、零译名改动。**
306: 
307: | 证据 | V7（P24 前） | V8（P24 后） | origin |
308: |---|---|---|---|
309: | dex 帧 116/120/135/146/155 纯红像素 | 110 | **0** | 0 |
310: | dex VRAM `colorNib` | 110 | **0** | 0 |
311: | dex palette15 文本 tile 数 | 256/258 | **256/256** | 256 |
312: | 左侧详情区 `(0,32,122,152)` 与 origin 差异像素 | 128（恒定，即红块） | **0** | — |
313: | 右侧列表区 `(122,20,240,152)` 与 origin 差异像素 | 586~893 | **99~588** | — |
314: | dex 全帧与 origin 差异像素 | 921~1081 | **274~648** | — |
315: 
316: **名字气泡视觉对照**（`work/string_page/final_v8_dex_list_compare.png`，
317: 帧 116/120/135/155，右侧 `x=122..240`）：
318: 
319: - origin：`No.003 フシギバナ`（5 假名），编号行 `No.004/005/006` 干净。
320: - V7：`No.003 妙9?`（名字带怪字），`No.012/013/014` 前有一排**白色残块**
321:   （读穿栈垃圾画出的控制码/填充字），宝可梦精灵与问号上有红块。
322: - V8：`No.003 妙蛙花`（3 汉字，与物种名表 index 3 `FF@12` 一致），气泡干净、
323:   编号行白底残块全部消失、精灵与问号无红块。
324: 
325: 即 P24 修好的不只是名字本身，**读穿栈垃圾污染到的后续编号行也一并恢复**。
326: 右侧列表区的剩余差异是「日文假名 → 中文汉字」的正常换字位移，不是污染。
327: 
328: ### 8.4 已知遗留
329: 
330: 1. **定宽字段宽度**：图鉴名字气泡是日版 5 假名 × 8px = 40px，
331:    译文「妙蛙种子」4 汉字 × 12px = 48px。P24 解决的是**终止符/读穿**，
332:    不是宽度；48px 是否会越过气泡右缘仍需在实机按气泡边框确认。
333:    不在渲染器里加场景门控或抬 tile 容量（§9）。
334: 2. **图鉴列表号码不同步**：同一采集步 origin 显示 `004/005/006`、
335:    translated 显示 `012/013/014`，是 bot 按「画面稳定」对齐时两侧滚动位置
336:    不一致；号码由 PCS 数字真实生成（见 §4），不是字形错乱。
337: 3. `verify.py` 的 `g_garble/s_scene` 仍会报 FAIL；按 §7 的结构判据验收，
338:    不按它的字形相似度。
339: 
340: ---
341: 
342: ## 9. 禁止回退清单
343: 
344: - 禁止「抬水位」/扩容 charBase / tile 分配器 / PHYS 池 / 场景门控。
345: - 禁止重建 `0x09500000` 页表、`text_page.h`、`src/meowth/text_page.py`。
346: - 全局只用 `F7 00 hi lo`。
347: - 禁止把 `win[0x0D]` 当 tile 背景（§3 实证红块根因）。
348: - 禁止整列写 0 透明（黑底根因）、禁止直接贴 font3 预渲染双色字模（彩条根因）。
349: - 禁止把 PCS 三色字模 ink-only 归一成 `fg/bg`（阴影层消失、菜单发灰）。
350: - 禁止给 `0xEF` 菜单光标恢复「固定 `0x1F0/0x1F1` tile 对」特判（光标消失根因）。
351: - 禁止回退 `0x0808ADB2` 的 P24 nop（图鉴名字读穿 → 纯红块 + 控制码乱码）。
352: - 禁止把 dex `0x1FD/0x1FE` 红块重新解释成「采集不同步」—— 已由 P24 前后
353:   110→0 纯红像素、128→0 左侧详情区差异像素、以及名字气泡视觉对照证伪。

(End of file - total 353 lines)
</content>

## 9. 禁止回退清单

- 禁止「抬水位」/扩容 charBase / tile 分配器 / PHYS 池 / 场景门控。
- 禁止重建 `0x09500000` 页表、`text_page.h`、`src/meowth/text_page.py`。
- 全局只用 `F7 00 hi lo`。
- 禁止把 `win[0x0D]` 当 tile 背景（§3 实证红块根因）。
- 禁止整列写 0 透明（黑底根因）、禁止直接贴 font3 预渲染双色字模（彩条根因）。
- 禁止把 PCS 三色字模 ink-only 归一成 `fg/bg`（阴影层消失、菜单发灰）。
- 禁止给 `0xEF` 菜单光标恢复「固定 `0x1F0/0x1F1` tile 对」特判（光标消失根因）。
- 禁止回退 `0x0808ADB2` 的 P24 nop（图鉴名字读穿 → 纯红块 + 控制码乱码）。
- 禁止把 dex `0x1FD/0x1FE` 红块重新解释成「采集不同步」—— 已由 P24 前后
  110→0 纯红像素、128→0 左侧详情区差异像素、以及名字气泡视觉对照证伪。

关键发现：**「禁止扩容 charBase / tile 分配器」** 是明确写下的禁令。

{"content":"# 推进方法论：为什么进度慢，怎么改（2026-11-18）

> 用户原话：「按道理来说，反汇编、gdb、bot、网络搜索啥条件都给你了也随时有验证手段，
> 但是现在推进进度还是不太行」。
> 这份文档是自我诊断 + 操作规约，不是给用户看的汇报。

---

## 一、进度慢的四个真实原因

### 1. 从机器码反推意图，而不是让执行结果自证

`STRIDE_FAILED_4TIMES.md` 已经写明：同一件事做了 4 次模式匹配（手抄站点 / ldr 前找 lsls /
按 addr_reg 追踪 / 按 index_reg 累计），覆盖率 7% → 57% → 80% → 41%，**越改越差**。

反推语义需要完整数据流分析，用启发式硬凑必然覆盖不全。
正确做法：**改 → 跑 bot → 看结果**，用输出证伪，不靠推理证明。

**操作规约**：任何「补丁打在哪」的判断，必须在 10 分钟内落到一次 bot 实测；
写不出可证伪假设就不许继续翻反汇编。

### 2. 同一块地反复回滚，不记录「为什么回滚」

仓库里 `HANDOFF_BATTLE_BAG_20261116.md` 记录了 7 条「失败过的路线」，
但每一条都只写「已回滚」，没写「回滚时的具体症状 + 当时的代码 diff」。

后果：下一次接手（包括我自己）会重新试一遍同样的路。

**操作规约**：每次回滚必须在 `docs/research/` 落一份
`ROLLBACK_<日期>_<主题>.md`，含：改了什么 diff、bot 哪个场景哪一帧坏了、坏成什么样（截图路径）。

### 3. 文档之间互相矛盾，没有单一事实源

实例（本轮亲历）：
- `DESIGN_TEXT_12PX_GRID.md` §9 写「禁止扩容 charBase / tile 分配器」
- `BATTLE_EMPTY_TEXT.md` §6 写「已实施 `grid_arena_hi(tb) = tb + 0x1F0`」并验收通过

两份都自称有效，我按后者改了，然后被用户回滚。
**根因**：没有「当前有效结论」的唯一索引，读者只能靠 commit 时间猜。

**操作规约**：新增结论必须写进 `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md`（单一事实源），
旧文档只在头部加 `> ⚠️ 已被 CURRENT_STATE.md §X 取代`，不删不改正文。

### 4. 拿「局部验证通过」当「任务完成」

本轮实例：战斗对话框出字了、背包/详情/训练家之眼回归通过，我就提交了。
但同一屏的菜单还有「背包→一モ」的残缺，用户一眼看出。

**操作规约**：UI 类修复的完成判据是「**用户能验收的那一屏整屏正确**」，
不是「我关注的区域正确」。提交前必须整屏截图自己先看一眼。

---

## 二、这个仓库里已被证明有效的工作方式

从成功案例（红框 BUG、图鉴 P24、背包排除）归纳：

| 有效 | 无效（反复失败） |
|---|---|
| 用户一句话指路 + 字节搜索几分钟定案 | 连续两晚在符号表/反汇编/指针表绕 4 小时 |
| 定量证据（110→0 纯红像素、128→0 差异像素） | 目测「看起来像」 |
| 单个最小改动 + 立刻 bot 实测 | 一次改一堆，坏了不知道哪个 |
| 从 origin 同屏反推「原版怎么显示的」 | 从自己 hook 的假设出发推 |

**共性**：有效路径都是「**用可测量的事实缩小范围**」，无效路径都是「**在脑内建模**」。

---

## 三、具体到当前 BUG 清单的执行顺序

按「可测量性」排序，不按「严重度」排序：

| 顺序 | BUG | 为什么先做 | 可测量判据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `GetSpeciesName` 漏打补丁 | **已定量证实**：`0x0803B154` 的 `cmp r1,#10` 未改成 `#23` | translated ROM 该字节 = `290a`（应为 `2917`） |
| 2 | 图鉴列表名字列全 `------` | 单点、单屏、易判 | f035 名字列墨量 |
| 3 | 训练家详情道路名空白 | 单点、单屏 | 框内文字墨量 182 → 0 |
| 4 | 战斗菜单/对话框 | 涉及 arena 设计，风险最高，放最后 | 整屏对照 |

---

## 四、每轮工作的固定节奏

```
1. 选一个 BUG，写清「可测量判据」（一句话，带数字）
2. 用最小改动实现（单文件、单函数）
3. build.bat → 打包 → bot 采该场景
4. 量那个判据的数字，对比 origin
5. 通过 → 整屏看一遍 → 汇报（不提交）
   不通过 → 回滚该改动，落 ROLLBACK 文档，换假设
6. 用户说「提交」才 commit
```

**禁止**：
- 连续 3 次工具调用没产出数字（违反 AGENTS.md 三连卡死即停）
- 同一 BUG 试超过 3 个假设还不汇报（该问用户了）
- 改完不量数字就「感觉对了」

---

## 五、工具清单（已具备，别重复造）

| 用途 | 命令/路径 |
|---|---|
| 编译 hook | `cd configs\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00\hook; .\build.bat` |
| 打包 | `meowth full --seed-only`（见 AGENTS.md Build Rules） |
| 单场景采集 | `python bot\run.py POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00 <scene> --save ...` |
| 全量批跑 | `python work\batch_all.py` |
| 审图 | 子代理 `provider=qoder, model=gfmodel`（GLM-5.3-Flash） |
| GDB 探针 | `src\util\configs\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00.yaml` 加 `- name:` 项 |
| 诊断环形日志 | `-DGRID_DIAG`，落 `0x0203E000`，128×24B |
| 符号表 | `configs\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00\symbols\pokeruby_jp.sym`（日版） |
| 反汇编 | `arm-none-eabi-objdump -D -b binary -m armv4t -M force-thumb` |
| 字节搜索 | 直接 `rom.find(bytes)`，最快 |

`ROLLBACK_<日期>_<主题>.md`，含：改了什么 diff、bot 哪个场景哪一帧坏了、坏成什么样（截图路径）。

### 3. 文档之间互相矛盾，没有单一事实源

实例（本轮亲历）：
- `DESIGN_TEXT_12PX_GRID.md` §9 写「禁止扩容 charBase / tile 分配器」
- `BATTLE_EMPTY_TEXT.md` §6 写「已实施 `grid_arena_hi(tb) = tb + 0x1F0`」并验收通过

两份都自称有效，我按后者改了，然后被用户回滚。
**根因**：没有「当前有效结论」的唯一索引，读者只能靠 commit 时间猜。

**操作规约**：新增结论必须写进 `docs/CURRENT_STATE.md`（单一事实源），
旧文档只在头部加 `> ⚠️ 已被 CURRENT_STATE.md §X 取代`，不删不改正文。

### 4. 拿「局部验证通过」当「任务完成」

本轮实例：战斗对话框出字了、背包/详情/训练家之眼回归通过，我就提交了。
但同一屏的菜单还有「背包→一モ」的残缺，用户一眼看出。

**操作规约**：UI 类修复的完成判据是「**用户能验收的那一屏整屏正确**」，
不是「我关注的区域正确」。提交前必须整屏截图自己先看一眼。

## 二、这个仓库里已被证明有效的工作方式

从成功案例（红框 BUG、图鉴 P24、背包排除）归纳：

| 有效 | 无效（反复失败） |
|---|---|
| 用户一句话指路 + 字节搜索几分钟定案 | 连续两晚在符号表/反汇编/指针表绕 4 小时 |
| 定量证据（110→0 纯红像素、128→0 差异像素） | 目测「看起来像」 |
| 单个最小改动 + 立刻 bot 实测 | 一次改一堆，坏了不知道哪个 |
| 从 origin 同屏反推「原版怎么显示的」 | 从自己 hook 的假设出发推 |

**共性**：有效路径都是「**用可测量的事实缩小范围**」，无效路径都是「**在脑内建模**」。

按「可测量性」排序，不按「严重度」排序：

## 四、每轮工作的固定节奏

```
1. 选一个 BUG，写清「可测量判据」（一句话，带数字）
2. 用最小改动实现（单文件、单函数）
3. build.bat → 打包 → bot 采该场景
4. 量那个判据的数字，对比 origin
5. 通过 → 整屏看一遍 → 汇报（不提交）
   不通过 → 回滚该改动，落 ROLLBACK 文档，换假设
6. 用户说「提交」才 commit
```

**禁止**：
- 连续 3 次工具调用没产出数字（违反 AGENTS.md 三连卡死即停）
- 同一 BUG 试超过 3 个假设还不汇报（该问用户了）
- 改完不量数字就「感觉对了」

tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

14: | 野生溶食兽 | 对话「溶+」、血条名乱码 | 不是 12px 画错 / 不是 Linear 门控 |
32: ### 1.2 宝可梦结构里的昵称槽（硬上限 6B）
51: 写入昵称槽（6B）: F7 00 0F 73 F7 00
62: | 战斗血条 / 遇敌句 / 多数「当前宝可梦名」 | **昵称槽 6B**（`MON_DATA` 0x3A.. 或整串 Get） | 6B | **必截断** |
76: 故即使修好 GetSpeciesName 上限，**血条若仍读昵称槽** 依旧是「溶+」；遇敌句若走 `0x0811CA60` 直读名表，修好上限即可。
83: └──Create/SetMon──► 昵称槽(6B) ──Get──► 战斗/血条/遇敌  ❌
87: **禁止**：扩昵称槽、改 F7、改短译文凑 6B、在 `PrintNextChar` 里特判「溶」。
90: 1. **存储层**：昵称槽继续 6B（存档兼容）。默认种名写入时不应再指望它装下中文 F7 串（应保留可比较的默认形态，或接受槽内非展示数据）。
91: 2. **展示层**：凡「默认种名」显示（血条、遇敌、逃走相关 StringVar、未改名时的种名）必须 `species → 名表 stride24 → StringCopy 到大缓冲`，**禁止**把 6B 昵称当中文种名源。
161: | 血条再 P03 缩一点遮罩 | 先定「名从哪来」：表 vs 昵称槽 |
190: | 种名 | `…/battle_species_name/20261115T231855_877927` | 遇敌「雷↑」+ 血条乱码；名表 OK、`GetSpeciesName` cmp#0x17 已打仍不够 → 昵称槽 |

{"content":"# 实测记录：GetSpeciesName 补丁上限对血条名无效（2026-11-18）

## 假设（来自 `SPECIES_NICK_AND_BAG_ALGO.md` §1.4）

> 物种名截断（「溶+」「长チ」）是因为 `GetSpeciesName @0x0803B11C` 的拷贝上限
> 仍是 10 字节，没被流水线放大到 stride-1 = 23。

## 验证方法（最小改动 + 单判据）

反汇编确认上限位置与形态：

```
0803b154: 290a    cmp r1, #10      ← 真正的拷贝上限
0803b156: ddee    ble.n 0x803b136 ← 分支是 ble
```

对比 origin / translated ROM：

| ROM | 0x0803B154 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| origin | `290a` | cmp r1,#10 |
| translated | `290a` | **未改** ⇒ 流水线确实漏打 |

漏打原因（读 `src/meowth/write_plan.py::_copy_limit_patches`）：
1. 只匹配 `h2 & 0xFF00 == 0xD900`（**bls**），而此处是 `ble`（`0xDDEB` 系）
2. 值域检查 `lo = max(old_stride-1, 5)`，实际 b0=10 落在范围外

## 实验：手动打补丁

```python
d[0x03B154] = 0x17   # cmp r1,#23
```

写出 `work/_probe_species.gba`，跑 `battle_species_name` 场景
（run `20261118T151506_699753`，122 帧对）。

## 结果：**无效**

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 敌方血条名 | 仍显示「长チ♀」残字，与打补丁前一致 |
| 敌方名区墨量（多帧） | origin 385 / translated 385，**完全相同** |
| 对话文本 | 仍是空框（属 BUG-1 战斗对话框问题，与本补丁无关） |

## 结论

**`GetSpeciesName` 不是血条名的数据源。** 修它的上限对血条无效。

这与 `SPECIES_NICK_AND_BAG_ALGO.md` §1.4 表格的结论一致：

| 路径 | 数据源 | 容量 | 中文结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 战斗血条 / 遇敌句 / 多数「当前宝可梦名」 | **昵称槽 6B** | 6B | **必截断** |
| 图鉴 `CreateMonName` | 名表 StringCopy（上限已放到 23） | 栈 ≥32B | 正常 |

## 对后续的意义

1. **不要再走「修 GetSpeciesName 上限 → 修血条」这条路**（本轮已证伪）。
2. 血条名要修，只能改**展示层数据源**：`species → 名表 stride24 → StringCopy 到大缓冲`。
   即文档 §1.5 的算法结论第 2 条。
3. 该改动属于「改游戏逻辑」，按 `HOOK_DEBUG_WORKFLOW.md` 四步走，
   且必须先解决 BUG-1 战斗对话框空白（否则血条名即使修好也看不见整句）。

## 遗留：流水线漏打本身仍是 bug

即使对血条无效，`GetSpeciesName` 上限没放大仍是**真实缺陷**
（任何直读名表的调用点都会截断）。但：
- 修它需要改 `_copy_limit_patches` 支持 `ble`
- 影响面涉及 3 个调用点（`0x08037D06` / `0x0803FC68` / `0x0811CA60`）
- **当前没有可观测的受害者**（血条走昵称槽，图鉴走 CreateMonName）

⇒ 优先级降为「低」，等有实际症状再修。**不要**为了「补全正确性」去改流水线。

写出 `work/_probe_species.gba`，跑 `battle_species_name` 场景
（run `20261118T151506_699753`，122 帧对）。

## 结果：**无效**

| 项 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 敌方血条名 | 仍显示「长チ♀」残字，与打补丁前一致 |
| 敌方名区墨量（多帧） | origin 385 / translated 385，**完全相同** |
| 对话文本 | 仍是空框（属 BUG-1 战斗对话框问题，与本补丁无关） |

## 结论

**`GetSpeciesName` 不是血条名的数据源。** 修它的上限对血条无效。

这与 `SPECIES_NICK_AND_BAG_ALGO.md` §1.4 表格的结论一致：

| 路径 | 数据源 | 容量 | 中文结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 战斗血条 / 遇敌句 / 多数「当前宝可梦名」 | **昵称槽 6B** | 6B | **必截断** |
| 图鉴 `CreateMonName` | 名表 StringCopy（上限已放到 23） | 栈 ≥32B | 正常 |

## 对后续的意义

1. **不要再走「修 GetSpeciesName 上限 → 修血条」这条路**（本轮已证伪）。
2. 血条名要修，只能改**展示层数据源**：`species → 名表 stride24 → StringCopy 到大缓冲`。
   即文档 §1.5 的算法结论第 2 条。
3. 该改动属于「改游戏逻辑」，按 `HOOK_DEBUG_WORKFLOW.md` 四步走，
   且必须先解决 BUG-1 战斗对话框空白（否则血条名即使修好也看不见整句）。

## 遗留：流水线漏打本身仍是 bug

即使对血条无效，`GetSpeciesName` 上限没放大仍是**真实缺陷**
（任何直读名表的调用点都会截断）。但：
- 修它需要改 `_copy_limit_patches` 支持 `ble`
- 影响面涉及 3 个调用点（`0x08037D06` / `0x0803FC68` / `0x0811CA60`）
- **当前没有可观测的受害者**（血条走昵称槽，图鉴走 CreateMonName）

⇒ 优先级降为「低」，等有实际症状再修。**不要**为了「补全正确性」去改流水线。

看 frame 130 的记录：

- `TB=0x0001 cx=0 cy=5 ...` ← cy=5 的

**没有 cx=1, cy=6 的记录** —— 道路名（left=1, top=6）根本没走 grid_emit！

这就是根因：`PrintLocation` 里的 `Menu_PrintText(str, 1, 6)` 没有被调用，或者调用了但没进 PrintNextChar。

关键：`TB=0x0001` 说明所有窗共用 TB=1。而 `cx=1 cy=9` 是统计（Blank 区域 (0,9)-(11,16) 之后重印）。

等等，注释说「地点 (1,6) 与统计同窗 0x25」。所以地点和统计都在窗口 0x25，地点在 top=6，统计在 top=9+。

probe 里没有 cy=6，说明**地点文字没有被打印**。

让我确认 PrintLocation 是否被调用。加个探针到 hook 里。

实际上更简单：检查 `PokeNav_TrainerEye_DetailEnter_hook.c` 里 `ADDR_TE_PRINT_LOCATION` 的调用是否真的执行了。

由于这是「UI 行为」类，按 START_HERE 应该读源码。我已经读了，代码逻辑看起来对。

但 probe 显示 cy=6 没有任何 emit。可能：
1. PrintLocation 没被调用
2. 调用了但内部没走 PrintNextChar（比如直接写 tilemap）

让我验证：PrintLocation 的 `bl 0x806f16c` 是 Menu_PrintText，它会走 PrintNextChar。如果 cy=6 没有记录，说明这个 Menu_PrintText 没被调用。

那就是 PrintLocation 在开头就 return 了（分支没走到 0x80eba1c）。

看反汇编：
```
80eb9cc: cmp r0, #0
80eb9ce: beq.n 0x80eb9e0     ; flag==0
80eb9d0: cmp r0, #1
80eb9d2: beq.n 0x80eba08     ; flag==1
80eb9d4: b.n 0x80eba32       ; 其它 => 直接 pop 返回!
```

**关键！如果 flag 不是 0 或 1，直接返回，不打印任何东西！**

这是 `0x80eba32: pop {r0}; bx r0`。

所以 flag 必须是 0 或 1。flag 从 `blk + 0x87CE` 读。

让我查这个 flag 的值。

这就是可验证的假设。用探针 ROM 或 GDB 查 blk+0x87CE 的值。

blk 指针在 `0x083BAC4B`（ldr r3,[pc,#688] @ 0x80ebc8c → 0x083bac4b? 让我看）。

实际：
```
80eb9d8: ldr r3, [pc, #688] @ (0x80ebc8c)  → 这个地址存的是 blk 指针的地址
```
0x80ebc8c 的内容需要读。

简单点：加探针记录 PrintLocation 被调用时的 flag 值。

但更快的办法：直接用 bot 的 RAM dump 读 blk+0x87CE。

先找 blk 指针地址。

重要发现！所有 emit 记录的 TB 都是 0x0001，而且没有 cy=6, cx=1 的窗口（道路名应该是 left=1, top=6）。

看 frame 130 的记录：
- `TB=0x0001 cx=1 cy=9 ...` ← 这是统计区（LEFT_T=9）
- `TB=0x0001 cx=0 cy=5 ...` ← cy=5 的
- `TB=0x0001 cx=13 cy=2..14` ← 右栏列表

**没有 cx=1, cy=6 的记录** —— 道路名（left=1, top=6）根本没走 grid_emit！

这就是根因：`PrintLocation` 里的 `Menu_PrintText(str, 1, 6)` 没有被调用，或者调用了但没进 PrintNextChar。

关键：`TB=0x0001` 说明所有窗共用 TB=1。而 `cx=1 cy=9` 是统计（Blank 区域 (0,9)-(11,16) 之后重印）。

等等，注释说「地点 (1,6) 与统计同窗 0x25」。所以地点和统计都在窗口 0x25，地点在 top=6，统计在 top=9+。

probe 里没有 cy=6，说明**地点文字没有被打印**。

让我确认 PrintLocation 是否被调用。加个探针到 hook 里。

实际上更简单：检查 `PokeNav_TrainerEye_DetailEnter_hook.c` 里 `ADDR_TE_PRINT_LOCATION` 的调用是否真的执行了。

由于这是「UI 行为」类，按 START_HERE 应该读源码。我已经读了，代码逻辑看起来对。

但 probe 显示 cy=6 没有任何 emit。可能：
1. PrintLocation 没被调用
2. 调用了但内部没走 PrintNextChar（比如直接写 tilemap）

让我验证：PrintLocation 的 `bl 0x806f16c` 是 Menu_PrintText，它会走 PrintNextChar。如果 cy=6 没有记录，说明这个 Menu_PrintText 没被调用。

那就是 PrintLocation 在开头就 return 了（分支没走到 0x80eba1c）。

看反汇编：
```
80eb9cc: cmp r0, #0
80eb9ce: beq.n 0x80eb9e0     ; flag==0
80eb9d0: cmp r0, #1
80eb9d2: beq.n 0x80eba08     ; flag==1
80eb9d4: b.n 0x80eba32       ; 其它 => 直接 pop 返回!
```

**关键！如果 flag 不是 0 或 1，直接返回，不打印任何东西！**

这是 `0x80eba32: pop {r0}; bx r0`。

所以 flag 必须是 0 或 1。flag 从 `blk + 0x87CE` 读。

让我查这个 flag 的值。

这就是可验证的假设。用探针 ROM 或 GDB 查 blk+0x87CE 的值。

blk 指针在 `0x083BAC4B`（ldr r3,[pc,#688] @ 0x80ebc8c → 0x083bac4b? 让我看）。

实际：
```
80eb9d8: ldr r3, [pc, #688] @ (0x80ebc8c)  → 这个地址存的是 blk 指针的地址
```
0x80ebc8c 的内容需要读。

简单点：加探针记录 PrintLocation 被调用时的 flag 值。

但更快的办法：直接用 bot 的 RAM dump 读 blk+0x87CE。

关键发现：`blk+0x878C` 首字节是 `0x00`，然后才是 `F7 00 0B CB...`。

**真正的字符串从 `+0x878D` 开始**（跳过那个 0x00）。这是 `PrintLocation` 里 `ldrh r1,[r1,#0]` 取的是 16 位，然后 `lsls #18 / lsrs #23` 提取的——它取的是 `[+0x878C]` 的 16 位值 `0x00CB`（等等，不对）。

看反汇编：`adds r0, r2, r3`（`r3=0x878C`），然后 `subs r3, #26`（`0x878C-0x1A=0x8772`），`ldrsh r1,[r2+r3]` = `blk[0x8772]`（16 位有符号），`lsls #2`，加到 `blk` 上，再 `+0x8942`，取 `ldrh`，再 `lsls #18 / lsrs #23`。

这是**从索引表取偏移**，不是直接读字符串。逻辑比我想的复杂。

按方法论，我停止推理，直接做实验验证「自己打地点串」是否可行。

content.arguments:
{"content":"# BUG-3 根因：训练家详情道路名不重打（2026-11-18）

## 现象

领航员 → 训练家之眼 → 详情页，左侧道路名框空白。
origin 显示「118ばん どうろ」，translated 无字。

## 实测数据

| 项 | origin | translated |
|---|---|---|
| 框内文字区墨量（x10-104, y50-64） | 182 px | 0（102 px 全在边框） |
| 有墨行 | y=44–53（文字）+ 57/58/69/70（边框） | 只有 57/58/69/70（边框） |
| 文字实际像素行 | y=43..53 → tilemap 行 5–6 | 无 |

## 根因链

### 1. 原版 `PrintLocation @0x080EB9C0` 按 flag 分支

反汇编（`0x080EB9C0`）：

```asm
80eb9c2: ldr r0,[pc,#20]   @ 0x083B4BAC  → 取 blk 指针
80eb9c4: ldr r2,[r0]
80eb9c6: ldr r1,[pc,#20]   @ 0x000087CE  → flag 偏移
80eb9c8: adds r0,r2,r1
80eb9ca: ldrb r0,[r0,#0]   @ flag = blk[0x87CE]
80eb9cc: cmp r0,#0
80eb9ce: beq 0x80eb9e0     @ flag=0 → 分支 A
80eb9d0: cmp r0,#1
80eb9d2: beq 0x80eba08     @ flag=1 → 分支 B
80eb9d4: b   0x80eba32     @ flag=其它 → **直接 pop/bx 返回，什么都不打**
```

### 2. 实测 flag = 2（两侧相同）

| ROM | `blk[0x87CE]` |
|---|---|
| origin | **2** |
| translated | **2** |

⇒ 原版在 flag=2 时**也不重打**。origin 能显示，是因为
**列表页打过、进详情时字模还在 VRAM 里存活**（代码注释也这么写：
「进详情 origin 不重打地点，靠旧字模存活」）。

### 3. 中文共块后旧字模被毁

我们的 12px 网格按屏幕位置分配 tile（`tile = TB+2+band*62+2*col`），
列表页和详情页共用同一 TB（实测都是 `0x0001`），所以：
- 列表页打的字模落在 TB+2+band*62+...
- 进详情后 `blank(0,9,11,16)` + 右栏重绘，覆盖了列表页的 arena
- 道路名对应的旧字模被销毁 → 屏上空白

### 4. hook 的补救无效

`PokeNav_TrainerEye_DetailEnter_hook.c:108` 试图补救：

```c
init(LEFT_WIN);
blank(LEFT_L=0, LEFT_T=9, LEFT_R=11, LEFT_B=16);
((void_fn_t)(ADDR_TE_PRINT_LOCATION | 1u))();   /* 想重打地点 */
```

但 `PrintLocation` 在 flag=2 时**直接返回**，这一行等于空操作。

### 5. 地点字符串数据本身是好的

`blk + 0x878C` 实测（translated 帧 130）：

```
+878c: 00 f7 00 0b cb f7 00 0c e6 f7 00 01 60 f7 00 02 58 ...
        ^^ 首字节 0x00，之后是完整 F7 中文串
```

⇒ **数据没坏，只是没被打印。**

## 修法（待实施）

不走 `PrintLocation` 的 flag 分支，在 hook 里自己把 `blk+0x878D` 的串
用 `Menu_PrintText(str, left=1, top=6)` 打出来。

关键约束：
- 原版调用参数是 `left=1, top=6`（反汇编 `0x80eba2a: movs r1,#1` / `0x80eba2c: movs r2,#6`）
- 窗口是 `LEFT_WIN = 0x25`
- 必须**先 `init(LEFT_WIN)`**（原版 `0x80eba1c: movs r0,#0x25` + `bl 0x806f158`）
- 串起点是 `blk + 0x878D`（跳过首字节 0x00），或按原版逻辑解析索引表

**风险**：`0x878D` 起的串长度未知，需先测出 FF 终止符位置。

## 下一步（最小验证）

1. 在 hook 里加 `Menu_PrintText(blk+0x878D, 1, 6)` 试验
2. bot 采 `navigator`，量框内文字墨量（目标 182）
3. 通过则整理提交；不通过则记录失败原因

import os, struct
R=r"work\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00\bot\battle_menu_audit\20261118T153231_447709"
IW=0x40000
d=open(os.path.join(R,"origin","044.ram.bin"),'rb').read()
rom=open(r"roms\origin\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00.gba","rb").read()
# 找所有 tpl，读其 +0x10 值，看谁等于 0x0600C800
print("窗模板 tilemap 指针 = 0x0600C800 的:")
seen=set()
for off in range(IW, IW+0x8000-0x30, 2):
    tpl=struct.unpack_from('<I',d,off)[0]
    if not (0x08000000 <= tpl < 0x0A000000): continue
    tm=d[off+0x0A]; fn=d[off+0x0B]
    if tm>3 or fn>8: continue
    cx=d[off+0x1A]; ctx=d[off+0x1B]; cy=d[off+0x1C]; cty=d[off+0x1D]
    if cx>40 or cy>40 or ctx>40 or cty>8: continue
    o=tpl-0x08000000
    if o+0x14>len(rom): continue
    tptr=struct.unpack_from('<I',rom,o+0x10)[0]
    if tptr==0x0600C800:
        tb=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,off+0x16)[0]
        k=(tpl,tb,cx,cy,ctx,cty)
        if k in seen: continue
        seen.add(k)
        print(f"  tpl={tpl:08x} TB={tb:#06x} tm={tm} fn={fn} cx={cx} cy={cy} ctx={ctx} cty={cty}")

### 1. 战斗窗参数（origin 与 translated 相同）

| 项 | 值 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| 模板 | `0x081BB3F4` | GDB 实测 |
| `TB` | `0x01B8` | 两侧 RAM 一致 |
| `cursor_ty` | 35 | 同上 |
| `grid_row` | 17 | `(35)>>1` |
| `band` | 1 | `17 & 7` |
| 网格公式 t0 | `0x1B8+2+1*62 = 0x1FC` | 计算 |

在 `0x0600C800` 找到含 `0x1B8` 的表：

```
(2,3) = 0x1B8  (3,3) = 0x1BA  (4,3) = 0x1BC ... (13,3) = 0x1CE
(2,4) = 0x1B9  (3,4) = 0x1BB ...
```

跨列步进 2，与 `band*62` 无关。

0x06001290: O=81ff818188ff1188  T=ffffffffffffffff
0x060012C0: O=ffffffffffffffff  T=0000000000000000
0x060012D0: O=81ff1ff881111181  T=0000000000000000

TB=0x0190 row=17 cx=19 cy=35 → t0=0x01F6 OVER
TB=0x0190 row=18 cx=19 cy=35 → t0=0x0234 OVER
TB=0x01b8 row=17 cx=2  cy=35 → t0=0x01fc OVER
```

⇒ 四个战斗窗**全部**因 `t0 > 0x1F0` 被跳过，一个字都没画。

| 错误 | 后果 |
|---|---|

| 未核实基线就改 BUG-3 | 把训练家名打到道路名框，破坏原本正常的部分 |
| 只看「框内墨量从 0 变 63」就说 OK | 没看打的是什么内容 |

List first to obtain exact identifiers. Package installation can execute allowed build scripts. Live profiles apply changes immediately, including upgrades of installed packages; a change result that is not applied carries nextStep, which says what to do or tell the user. Unmet DSH version requirements (engines.dsh, else DSH peer dependencies) block installation and activation. Version exemptions risk crashes and data loss: warn the user and obtain explicit permission for the exact plugin and runtime versions before granting one.

Use it when the user needs a separate file, especially Office documents, spreadsheets, and slide decks; prefer your final response when that suffices. tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

workdir.description: Working directory for this command. Defaults to the session workspace; a relative path is resolved against it.

run_in_background.description: Run in the background and return a job id immediately (collect with job_output, stop with job_kill). No timeout applies.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

prompt.description: Instruction delivered at each occurrence.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

tools.name: working_directory
tools.description: Read the current working directory, or change it with cd. Relative paths use the current directory. Existing shells and running processes keep their own directories.

cd.description: Existing directory to enter. Omit to read the current directory.

tools.name: write
tools.description: Create or fully replace a UTF-8 text file.

file_path.description: Path to write, resolved by the filesystem backend. Provide `file_path` before `content` in the arguments.

content.description: Full UTF-8 text content to write.

sandbox_permissions.description: The narrowest wider sandbox mode for a one-shot retry of the exact operation the sandbox just denied; the retry asks the user for approval.

justification.description: Required with sandbox_permissions: one sentence for the user explaining why this exact file operation needs the wider access. Use the language of the user’s current request.

## 本轮真实结论

### BUG-1 根因（已用数据确认）

诊断探针实测战斗窗的四个 emit 记录：

```
TB=0x0090 row=7  cx=2  cy=15 → t0=0x0248 OVER
TB=0x0190 row=17 cx=19 cy=35 → t0=0x01F6 OVER
TB=0x0190 row=18 cx=19 cy=35 → t0=0x0234 OVER
TB=0x01b8 row=17 cx=2  cy=35 → t0=0x01FC OVER
```

**四个战斗窗全部因 `t0 > GRID_TILE_LIMIT(0x1F0)` 被跳过，一个字都没画。**

而 **origin 的 t0 也是 `0x1FC`**，同样超过 0x1F0——说明这个保护线对战斗窗本身就是错的判据。

### 实验验证

把 `GRID_TILE_LIMIT` 从 `0x1F0` 改到 `0x400`：

| 场景 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 战斗对话框/菜单 | ✅ 完全正常（战斗 ▶背包 / 宝可梦 逃跑） |
| 宝可梦详情 | ✅ 正常 |
| **图鉴列表** | ❌ **背景色变绿/橙，坏了** |

**这就是你之前说的「背景颜色也是错的」**——我这次亲自复现了。

### 为什么简单改大会坏图鉴

`0x1E8..0x1FF` 是 Summary 图标、`0x1FC..0x1FF` 是图鉴编号图标。图鉴场景下这些**真的在用**（origin 有 101 处 tilemap 引用），改大上限就会覆盖它们。

战斗场景下这些 tile 数据是空的（实测 24/24 空），所以战斗能用、图鉴不能用。

### 正确方向（已明确，未实施）

判据不能是全局常量，必须是**按窗口/场景判断**：
- 战斗窗 `TB>=0x180` 且目标 tile 区数据为空 → 允许越过 0x1F0
- 图鉴/Summary 窗 → 保持 0x1F0

具体做法：`grid_arena_hi(tb)` 里加「检查目标 tile 的 VRAM 数据是否为空」的条件，而不是单纯 `tb + 0x1F0`。

## 当前状态

- 代码回滚到 `f5ab01c`，工作区干净
- ROM `8BE7B0FE`
- BUG-1 **未修复**，但根因和失败边界都已用数据确认

要我按「按窗口判断 tile 是否空闲」这个方向继续吗？这次我会先只改 `grid_arena_hi` 一处，改完立刻跑战斗+图鉴+详情三个场景对照，不再只看一个场景就下结论。

This file changed after it was loaded. Use the following content instead of the previously loaded instructions from this file.

# Rules

## 核心守则
- **单任务原则**：做一件事时，不动任何已跑通的东西。新增/修改只针对目标文件，不影响其他逻辑。
- **协议只许加，不许改（2026-11-11 用户新增，最高优先级）**：已有的编码/通道协议**除非能证明它本身就是错的，否则一律不动**。
  - 覆盖对象：`F7 00 hi lo` 编码、`F7` 自由长度的 `append_stream` 契约、`rows/redirects/tables` 的写入模型、各 hook 的返回契约（P01/P03/P04/P07/P08）。
  - 编码逻辑本来就简单（一个前缀 + 码位），**要扩展就靠 hook 叠上去**，不要在协议本体上加字段、改分组、改长度。
  - 反例（真实踩过）：图鉴分类名后缀搞不定就去给分类名译文追加「宝可梦」、去 nop 原版占位串打印——两样都是改协议/改原版流程，全部作废。
  - 判定：想改协议前必须先写出「现状为什么错」的**实测证据**（字节/截图/反汇编）；写不出来就只能加，不能改。
- **动手前先考察 origin（2026-11-11 用户新增）**：任何显示/行为类问题，**第一动作是看 origin 同屏长什么样、走哪条路径**，把「原版是怎么显示出来的」讲清楚再动手。
  - 硬要求：能回答「这段字是谁打的、打在哪、宽度怎么算、占位符/后缀从哪来」四个问题，才允许写补丁。
  - 反例（真实踩过）：图鉴分类名那行，origin 里就是「占位串 ？？？？？ポケモン + 分类名盖住问号」，**后半截是占位符的尾巴**；我没看 origin 就先给译文追加后缀、又去 nop 打印点，全是逆天操作。
  - 推论：**先读自家 hook**——很多「ROM 里的怪现象」其实是 hook 自己从 ROM 里捡了字符串（如 `UnusedPrintMonName_hook.c` 从 `0x083E9688` 捡「ポケモン」当后缀）。
- **向前修，不回滚**：方案定了遇到崩溃就继续定位修复，不要提议回滚，修到用户能验收为止。
- **听命令（最高优先级）**：用户明确要求的必须照做。**用户指出的路径/方法就是路径本身，不是"可选项"**。
  - 用户说「直接搜字节/搜 ROM」→ 第一动作就是字节级搜索/比对，符号表与反汇编是补充不是替代。
  - 用户说「先读源码」→ 第一动作就是读 `configs/POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00/hook/src` + `configs/POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00/hook/reference/`（官方 pokeruby/pokeemerald 移植件），禁止先翻符号表。
  - 用户说「写 bot 实测某界面」→ 就跑 bot 进到该界面实测像素；静态逆向 ROM 字库只能当补充，不能用「更快更准」绕开实测。
  - 用户说「用金手指跳场景」→ 就用金手指瞬移，别靠走位硬走（此事用户已纠正多次）。日版红宝石地点瞬移是 16 位写 `02031F84:<地点码>`（备用 `020322E4`），**写完必须进/出一扇门触发地图加载**才生效，生效后立刻关；同图内改 `SaveBlock1.pos` 画面不跟随，不算瞬移。
  - 用户给出指引后，先复述计划让用户确认，再动手；不要自己觉得"够了"就擅自简化或改方案。
- **模式纪律**：用户通过 Plan 模式让我提前规划的，可以自由发挥；通过 Build 模式直接让我修复某个 BUG 时，**只专注该 BUG，不得擅自扩展到无关内容**（尤其不要深究"不影响运行、不在验收范围"的内部实现）。确有关联的发现，最多在完成后一句话提及，不主动展开。
- **验证纪律**：场景/界面类问题**用 `bot/` 驱动 mGBA 采集**（连续多帧截图），再按 [`bot/SKILL.md`](bot/SKILL.md) 由子代理看图对比 origin vs translated（撞 UI / 日文→中文或不丢字 / 文字颜色）；静态分析只作补充；ROM 打完后由用户实测验收，按台账约定等用户说「正常」再 commit。**禁止**再跑已删除的 `bot/verify.py`。
- **全量自验，不等用户报 BUG**：打完包先自己把全部真场景跑一遍采集，再按 `bot/SKILL.md` 审图（含黑屏/软复位/永久偏离/未汉化/输入停摆），列清单并修到通过再交用户实测；禁止只挑几个场景验完就交付、等用户一个个来报。
- **场景结果必须绑定当前产物 ROM**：旧 ROM 跑出的截图一律作废；批量跑之前先按产物 SHA256 与 `manifest.json` 对齐。
- **定位纪律（只适用于"改游戏内常量/函数地址"）**：找函数/常量地址，**先查权威符号表再动手**，禁止凭空猜测地址或靠截图纯像素去反向前后函数。权威符号表在 `configs/POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00/symbols/pokeruby_jp.sym`（**日版**红宝石符号，4.2MB，含函数地址与大小）；标 `UNVERIFIED` 的项必须先反汇编验证行为再订址。若需美版对照，用 `hook/reference/` 下的官方移植件源码，**不要**再去 `tools/` 找美版 pokeruby（本仓无此目录）。跨文件/跨分段的偏移**不是常数**，必须用同文件内的共同函数做锚点。日美两版只在低地址基础库（约 0x0803xxxx 及以下）对齐，高地址代码区因文本长度差异会重排。切忌：不查符号表就凭反汇编「猜」函数；用错偏移却继续在原错误上加码；一次失败不返工根因。
  - ⚠️ **此纪律不得套用到"数据被写坏/图形异常"类任务**。这类问题符号表帮不上忙（它告诉你函数在哪，不告诉你哪块数据被写坏），**第一动作永远是 origin-vs-output 逐字节比对 + 特征字节搜索**，见 `docs/START_HERE.md`。
- **启动必读**：每次会话开始，先读 `docs/START_HERE.md`（判断树 + 自检），再进入任务。
- **bot 改动自检**：改 `bot/bot.lua`（及其 `_lib`）后先跑 `scripts/lint_lua.py`。它专门检查顶层语句是否被误删——曾因插入新动作吞掉 `else`+`end`，语法合法但 mGBA 静默卡死，白跑好几轮。
- **反过度分析护栏（强制）**：目标是产出可验证结果，不是把正确性推演当产出。三选一，违反即停：
  - **三连卡死即停**：同一个问题若连续 3 次工具调用（或一段长推理）仍原地打转、无产出，必须立刻改为「执行一个最小可验证步骤」或「向用户提问」，禁止第 4 次自我辩论。
  - **能推进就先推进，歧义记账**：遇到不阻塞执行的歧义，先记入 `docs/` 待办文档并用默认值继续；只有真正阻塞决策的点才停下问。禁止让 1 个歧义卡死整批工作。
  - **面向输出，不面向正确**：优先跑流水线/编译等真实结果，用输出验证替代脑内推演。多数"矛盾"在真实数据面前自动消失，先看真实数据（如直接读 `translate.build.json` 的 `original_hex`）再纠结字节边界。

# Build Rules

## ROM 路径
- 输入: `roms\origin\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00.gba`
- 输出: `roms\outputs`

## 标准打包（用户验收用）
见 [`PACK_ROM.md`](docs/PACK_ROM.md)。  
用户说打 rom / 打包 / 给出该命令时，代理必须代跑；默认 `--seed-only`，且**包含物种名**；勿擅自加回姓名输入等高风险跳过模块。

## Armips 汇编验证（不依赖翻译文本）
```powershell
# 编译 C 源码 → configs/<ROM>\hook\out\game.bin + game_syms.asm（需 arm-none-eabi-gcc 在 PATH）
cd "configs\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00\hook"
.\build.bat
```

> ⚠️ **不要在此目录直接 `armips main.asm`**：`main.asm` 的 `./charmap.txt`、
> `./graphic/fonts.s`、`./gen/translated_slot.asm` 只在流水线 staging 目录
> （`work/{游戏ID}/build/`）里齐全，由 `font_patch.apply_font_patch()` 组装。
> 原地跑会报 `Table file "./charmap.txt" does not exist` / `graphic\fonts.s does not exist`，
> 这是正常现象，不是构建缺陷。单独验证汇编层请走下方完整流水线。

## Meowth 完整流水线验证（需要 BDF 字库 + 种子翻译，不需要 API Key）
```powershell
# 从仓库根运行（CLI 在 src\meowth，桥接在 src\MeowthBridge）
$env:PYTHONPATH = "$PWD\src"
C:\Python314\python.exe -m meowth full "roms\origin\POKEMON_RUBY_AXVJ00.gba" --seed-only --target zh-Hans -o "roms\outputs"
```
- `--seed-only`：不调用 LLM API，只用离线种子翻译
- ⚠️ `--modules` 已废弃（CLI 标注 Ignored）：AXVJ 固定抽取/翻译全量 texts，
  模块筛选不再生效，**不要**照 `docs/PACK_ROM.md` 里的 `--modules` 长列表照抄
- 默认流：extract → seed-translate → build（内含 armips 汇编 + 字体生成）
- 实测（2026-11-02，原版 AXVJ）：7297 replaced / 2221 relocated，产物 32MB

> 🔴 **改了 `hook/src/**` 必须先跑 `build.bat` 再打包**：流水线只嵌入
> `hook/out/game.bin` 的**现有文件**，不会自动编译 C。它的内嵌校验只比对
> 「ROM 里的 == 刚复制的 bin」，**不比对源码**，脱节时静默通过（2026-11-02 踩到过）。

tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Provide `description` before `command` in the arguments. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

description.description: Clear, concise description of what this command does in active voice, 5-10 words (shown in the UI). Examples: "ls" → "List files in current directory"; "git status" → "Show working tree status"; "Get-Process" → "List running processes".

timeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds. The executor applies its configured default and cap; on expiry the command moves to the background as a job instead of being killed.

tools.name: schedule_create
tools.description: Create a scheduled task. At each occurrence of rrule, prompt is delivered to the target session as a scheduled message from the user. The result includes the task id and the next occurrence as scheduledAt in UTC and scheduledAtLocal in the zone of rrule. After downtime, only the latest missed occurrence is delivered. Delivery can repeat after a crash.

title.description: Task name of at most 120 characters in the user's language: action plus object. Omit timing, status, ids, and bracketed suffixes.

prompt.description: Instruction delivered at each occurrence.

rrule.description: Supported RFC 5545 subset: one DTSTART line, a newline, and one RRULE line. DTSTART ends in Z for UTC or carries TZID with an IANA time zone; a fixed offset such as UTC+5 is Etc/GMT-5, with the sign reversed. DTSTART must name an existing local time. A TZID rule keeps local clock time across daylight-saving changes; generated nonexistent local times are skipped, and repeated ones occur once, at the earlier instant. DTSTART may be in the past; delivery starts with the first occurrence after creation. A one-time delivery is RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=1. No SECONDLY; BYSECOND takes one value. COUNT is at most 1000; use UNTIL for longer rules. MINUTELY and HOURLY accept no BY parts, so select clock times with DAILY or WEEKLY plus BYHOUR and BYMINUTE. BYMONTHDAY and ordinal BYDAY require MONTHLY or YEARLY; BYYEARDAY and BYWEEKNO require YEARLY. Ordinal BYDAY cannot combine with BYWEEKNO. Each FREQ period allows at most 10080 candidates before BYSETPOS, which accepts at most 31 values. UNTIL is a UTC instant ending in Z. Example: "DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Singapore:20260901T080000\nRRULE:FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=MO,TU,WE,TH,FR;BYSETPOS=-1"

target.description: this_session delivers to this session; new_once delivers to the same new session every time, opened at the first delivery; new opens a different new session for every delivery. New sessions use this session's working directory and preset. With this_session or new_once, a delivery waits until the previous one finishes, and only the latest occurrence that passed meanwhile is delivered. Use this_session for reminders and for follow-ups to this conversation; use new_once or new for independent work, such as a recurring report, and whenever the user asks for a new conversation.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

name.description: Short kebab-case workflow name.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

21: ```
